license_required.quote: no person shall practice medicine or surgery in the State, either gratuitously or for pay, or offer to practice medicine or surgery in the State...without having a valid unrevoked license or a limited and temporary license obtained from the Hawaii medical board

issuing_authority.quote: without having a valid unrevoked license or a limited and temporary license obtained from the Hawaii medical board

name.quote: a valid unrevoked license or a limited and temporary license obtained from the Hawaii medical board

type.quote: "Board" means the board of dentistry, the Hawaii medical board, the board of psychology, the board of nursing, the Hawaii board of veterinary medicine, the board of acupuncture, the board of massage therapy, the board of naturopathic medicine, the Hawaii board of chiropractic, and the board of pharmacy.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of commerce and consumer affairs.
umbrella_agency.citation: UMBRELLA / 436B. Uniform Professional and Vocational Licensing Act

degree_required.value: M.D. or D.O. from accredited medical school, or graduate of foreign medical school with additional requirements
degree_required.quote: the applicant is a graduate of: (A) A medical school or college whose program leading to the M.D. degree is accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education or whose program leading to the D.O. degree is approved by the American Osteopathic Association Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME) for M.D.; American Osteopathic Association Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation for D.O.
accrediting_body.quote: A medical school or college whose program leading to the M.D. degree is accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education or whose program leading to the D.O. degree is approved by the American Osteopathic Association Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation

required.quote: has served a residency of at least one year in a program that has been accredited for the training of resident physicians or osteopathic physicians by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or the American Osteopathic Association

duration.value: at least one year (domestic graduates); at least two years (foreign medical graduates)
duration.quote: has served a residency of at least one year in a program that has been accredited for the training of resident physicians or osteopathic physicians by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or the American Osteopathic Association

kind.quote: has served a residency of at least one year in a program that has been accredited for the training of resident physicians or osteopathic physicians

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners examination (NBME)
exams.notes: Passing one of the listed exams satisfies the examination requirement
exams.quote: Applicants who have passed, with scores deemed satisfactory by the board, the National Board of Medical Examiners examination (NBME), the Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX), the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE), or a combination of these examinations as approved by the board, or the National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners examination (NBOME), the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA), or the Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination (MCCQE)...shall be licensed without the necessity of any further examination

exams.name: Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX)
exams.quote: the National Board of Medical Examiners examination (NBME), the Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX), the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE), or a combination of these examinations as approved by the board

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.quote: the National Board of Medical Examiners examination (NBME), the Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX), the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE), or a combination of these examinations as approved by the board

exams.name: National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners examination (NBOME)
exams.quote: the National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners examination (NBOME), the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA), or the Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination (MCCQE)

exams.name: Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)
exams.quote: the National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners examination (NBOME), the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA), or the Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination (MCCQE)

exams.name: Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination (MCCQE)
exams.quote: the National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners examination (NBOME), the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA), or the Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination (MCCQE)

interval_years.quote: Every physician or surgeon holding a license under this chapter shall renew the license with the board no later than January 31 of each even-numbered year.

required.quote: Every physician, osteopathic physician, or surgeon shall pay a renewal fee and comply with the category 1 or 1A continuing medical education requirements provided in rules adopted by the board.

period_years.quote: Every physician or surgeon holding a license under this chapter shall renew the license with the board no later than January 31 of each even-numbered year. Every osteopathic physician or surgeon holding a license previously issued under chapter 460 and this chapter shall renew the license with the board no later than June 30 of each even-numbered year. Every physician, osteopathic physician, or surgeon shall pay a renewal fee and comply with the category 1 or 1A continuing medical education requirements

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to a physician, surgeon, or osteopathic physician if: (1) The applicant: (A) Files an application and pays fees as prescribed by the board; (B) Holds a current, unencumbered, active license in a jurisdiction that requires qualifications substantially equivalent to or greater than the qualifications for licensure in this State

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current, unencumbered, active license in a jurisdiction with substantially equivalent or greater qualifications, and must have actively practiced medicine in another jurisdiction for at least two of the immediate preceding five years. No disciplinary action or adverse judgments constituting a pattern of negligence or incompetence.
requirements.quote: Holds a current, unencumbered, active license in a jurisdiction that requires qualifications substantially equivalent to or greater than the qualifications for licensure in this State as specified in section 453-4; and (C) Submits proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant has actively practiced medicine in another jurisdiction for at least two of the immediate preceding five years

regulatory_model.quote: no person shall practice medicine or surgery in the State, either gratuitously or for pay, or offer to practice medicine or surgery in the State...without having a valid unrevoked license

credential_type.quote: no person shall practice medicine or surgery in the State, either gratuitously or for pay...without having a valid unrevoked license or a limited and temporary license obtained from the Hawaii medical board

is_mandatory.quote: no person shall practice medicine or surgery in the State, either gratuitously or for pay, or offer to practice medicine or surgery in the State...without having a valid unrevoked license

title_protection.quote: append the letters "Dr.", "M.D.", or "D.O." to one's name with the intent to imply that the person is a practitioner of medicine or surgery, without having a valid unrevoked license

scope_protection.quote: no person shall practice medicine or surgery in the State, either gratuitously or for pay, or offer to practice medicine or surgery in the State...without having a valid unrevoked license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or aiding in procuring an abortion that is unlawful under Hawaii law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or aiding or abetting in procuring, an abortion that is unlawful under the laws of this State or that would be unlawful under the laws of this State if performed within this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing any person to solicit patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing any person to solicit patients for one's self

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, fraudulent, or deceptive advertising including excessive claims of expertise, assuring cure for incurable disease, or untruthful statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, fraudulent, or deceptive advertising, including but not limited to: (A) Making excessive claims of expertise in one or more medical specialty fields; (B) Assuring a permanent cure for an incurable disease; or (C) Making any untruthful and improbable statement in advertising one's medical or surgical practice or business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being habituated to excessive use of drugs or alcohol, or being addicted to narcotics or similar substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being habituated to the excessive use of drugs or alcohol; or being addicted to, dependent on, or a habitual user of a narcotic, barbiturate, amphetamine, hallucinogen, or other drug having similar effects

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine while impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental instability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental instability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring a license through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit, or permitting an unlicensed person to perform licensed activities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring a license through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit, or knowingly permitting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional misconduct, hazardous negligence causing bodily injury, or manifest incapacity in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional misconduct, hazardous negligence causing bodily injury to another, or manifest incapacity in the practice of medicine or surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence or multiple instances of negligence including consistent use of inappropriate or unnecessary medical services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence or multiple instances of negligence, including but not limited to the consistent use of medical service, which is inappropriate or unnecessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct or practice contrary to recognized standards of ethics of the medical profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct or practice contrary to recognized standards of ethics of the medical profession as adopted by the Hawaii Medical Association, the American Medical Association, the Hawaii Association of Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, or the American Osteopathic Association

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the conditions or limitations upon which a limited or temporary license is issued
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the conditions or limitations upon which a limited or temporary license is issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action by another state or federal agency of a license or medical privilege
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action by another state or federal agency of a license, certificate, or medical privilege

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a penal offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction, whether by nolo contendere or otherwise, of a penal offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician or osteopathic physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the uniform controlled substances act or any rule adopted thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of chapter 329, the uniform controlled substances act, or any rule adopted thereunder except as provided in section 329-122

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board any disciplinary decision issued against the licensee in another jurisdiction within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the board, in writing, any disciplinary decision issued against the licensee or the applicant in another jurisdiction within thirty days after the disciplinary decision is issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting to or filing with the board any false, untrue, or materially misleading document
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitting to or filing with the board any notice, statement, or other document required under this chapter, which is false or untrue or contains any material misstatement or omission of fact

definition_quote.value: the practice of medicine by a physician or an osteopathic physician includes the use of drugs and medicines; surgery; manual medicine; water; electricity; hypnotism; telehealth; the interpretation of tests, including primary diagnosis of pathology specimens, medical imaging, or any physical; osteopathic medicine; any means, method, or agent, either tangible or intangible, to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or correct disease, or prevent any human disease, condition, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, illness, infirmity, defect, physical or mental condition in the human subject.
definition_quote.quote: the practice of medicine by a physician or an osteopathic physician includes the use of drugs and medicines; surgery; manual medicine; water; electricity; hypnotism; telehealth; the interpretation of tests, including primary diagnosis of pathology specimens, medical imaging, or any physical; osteopathic medicine; any means, method, or agent, either tangible or intangible, to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or correct disease, or prevent any human disease, condition, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, illness, infirmity, defect, physical or mental condition in the human subject.

value: any means, method, or agent to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or correct disease
methods_authorized.quote: includes the use of drugs and medicines; surgery; manual medicine; water; electricity; hypnotism; telehealth; the interpretation of tests, including primary diagnosis of pathology specimens, medical imaging, or any physical; osteopathic medicine; any means, method, or agent, either tangible or intangible, to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or correct disease

drug_authority.value: Physicians may use drugs and medicines as part of the practice of medicine
drug_authority.quote: the practice of medicine by a physician or an osteopathic physician includes the use of drugs and medicines

license_status_types.quote: the boards shall have the following powers: (1) To establish by rule an inactive license category for those not currently practicing in the State, including the procedure and conditions for activation of the license; (2) To establish by rule a retired license category including the procedure and conditions for activation of the license.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must have at least two years of residency in an ACGME or AOA accredited program (or Canadian equivalent), and must hold the ECFMG national certificate (or equivalent), or the Fifth Pathway Program certificate of the AMA.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A foreign medical school and has had at least two years of residency in a program accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or the American Osteopathic Association...and: (i) Holds the national certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates, or its successor...or (ii) Holds the certificate of the Fifth Pathway Program of the American Medical Association

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: has served a residency of at least one year in a program that has been accredited for the training of resident physicians or osteopathic physicians by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or the American Osteopathic Association

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: For purposes of prescribing opiates via telehealth, a physician-patient relationship shall only be established after an in-person consultation between the prescribing physician and the patient.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: For the purposes of prescribing opiates or certifying a patient for the medical use of cannabis, a physician-patient relationship shall only be established after an in-person consultation between the prescribing physician and the patient.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Treatment recommendations via telehealth, including prescriptions, must meet the same standards as traditional physician-patient settings where prescribing is appropriate. Prescriptions based solely on an online questionnaire are not acceptable. For opiates or cannabis certification, an in-person consultation is required before establishing the physician-patient relationship.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Treatment recommendations made via telehealth, including issuing a prescription via electronic means, shall be held to the same standards of appropriate practice as those in traditional physician-patient settings that do not include [an] in-person visit but in which prescribing is appropriate...Issuing a prescription based solely on an online questionnaire is not treatment for the purposes of this section and does not constitute an acceptable standard of care. For the purposes of prescribing opiates or certifying a patient for the medical use of cannabis, a physician-patient relationship shall only be established after an in-person consultation between the prescribing physician and the patient.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The board shall establish the degree of supervision required by the supervising physician, osteopathic physician, or group of physicians when a physician assistant performs a service within the practice of medicine. A physician or osteopathic physician who does not supervise a physician assistant's services at the degree required by the board shall be deemed to have engaged in professional misconduct.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe including controlled substances; supervising physician must review at least 50% of controlled substance prescription records during the first year of supervision.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: For physician assistants who issue controlled substance prescriptions, at least fifty per cent of the records reviewed under clause (i) or (ii) shall include controlled substance prescriptions

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every physician or osteopathic physician licensed pursuant to this chapter who does not possess professional liability insurance shall report any settlement or arbitration award of a claim or action for damages for death or personal injury caused by negligence, error, or omission in practice

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Where the board has reasonable cause to believe that a licensee is or may be unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to protect patients, the board may order the licensee to submit to a mental or physical examination or any combination thereof, by a licensed practitioner approved by the board, at the licensee's expense.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may issue a limited and temporary license to a physician or osteopathic physician to maintain patient services for the purpose of substituting for another physician or osteopathic physician licensed in this State to enable specialized training at an out-of-state fully accredited medical teaching institution
